findings.description: The change to `is not None` also lets an empty `match=""` through, so `retry_if_exception_message(match="")` now compiles an empty pattern that matches every exception message instead of raising the TypeError it used to.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a caller passes match="", for example from an empty config value. Mechanism: re.compile("") matches any string at position 0, so _check returns True for every exception. Impact: the retry predicate silently retries all exceptions, which was previously rejected with a TypeError; the commit title only announces accepting an empty message.
